findings.title: Task-ids tasks are left unchecked although the feature is implemented
findings.why: T001–T003 are still `[ ]`, but the diff implements ids, `get` and id-or-title lookup, and adds tests. The other three specs have their tasks checked. The plan also describes a `Map<id, Task>` primary store, while the code keeps a title-keyed map plus an id-to-title map.
